svg.title: DJ’s garden
svg.desc: 2,373 contributions from Nov 4, 2025 to Nov 3, 2026, grown as an isometric garden. Languages: Python 34% (iris), Java 19% (poppy), JavaScript 15% (sunflower), TypeScript 7% (hydrangea), Vue 6% (daisy), C# 5% (camellia), C++ 5% (dahlia), other 5% (wildflower), CSS 4% (cosmos).
svg.text: 2,373 contributions in the last year · each tile is a day
